#Comparison of Cylindar Count to Engine Displacement

A client named Big Dawg has commissioned this work with the research question: 
Do cars with more cylinders not have bigger engines?

The goal of this report is to provide Big Dawg with clarity as to if cars with 
more cylinders have bigger or not.

This report will investigate the relationship between engine displacement and 
number of cylinders by using linear regression and the tools available on 
R studio.



```{r} 
library(tidyverse)
mtcars <- mtcars

my_table <- mtcars |>
  select(cyl, disp) |>
  summarise(disp_m = round(mean(disp), 2), 
            .by=cyl)

my_table <- my_table |>
  rename(Cylinders = cyl, 
         Displacement = disp_m)

knitr::kable(my_table, caption = 
               "Table 1: Mean engine displacement by number of cylinders") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

```
